title: Superimpregnation
summary: SUPERIMPREGNA'TION, noun [super and impregnation.] The act of impregnating upon a prior impregnation; impregnation when previously impregnated.

inlines.v: SUPERIMPREGNA'TION, noun [super and impregnation.] The act of impregnating upon a prior impregnation; impregnation when previously impregnated.
